claim_boundary: This preregistration freezes an independently generated positive free-atom promolecular reference-density source for the Route-2 V0-FD-S short-range channel. It is not an all-electron MACE density, a fitted cavity, a solvent interaction, a liquid functional, a solvation calculation, a force/PES result, or an accuracy claim.

declared_use.electrostatic_channel: Only the unmodified MACE Gaussian source provides solute electrostatics.
declared_use.short_range_channel: The positive promolecular density may later be used only as an independently sourced input to a separately admitted short-range functional.
declared_use.element_domain: H, C, N, O, S, and Cl cover the declared chemistry of the eleven registered default solvents. Other elements and ionic reference states fail closed until separately preregistered.
declared_use.scope_limit: The asset is not a total solvent model and cannot be combined with a hand-chosen overlap coefficient, SMD-CDS, GAFF/AM1-BCC substitution, or a benchmark-selected correction.

decision_rule: A failed SCF, negative density sample, electron-count normalization failure, spherical-average failure, radial-tail failure, source hash mismatch, or provenance violation rejects the asset. Passing the asset gates says only that a positive independent reference density is available; it does not admit a short-range functional or any solvation score.
